submitted.rationale: Of the 5 compositions measured, Sb 0.30 gave the highest EQE (0.029%). Sb 0.36 was close behind (0.025%). EQE falls off sharply at Sb 0.19, which was negative, and near the Pb2Sb2O7 (0.50) and PbSb2O6 (0.67) compositions, both about 0.006%. So the peak is in the Pb-rich range, about Sb 0.28–0.36.
